title: “What’s new” update notifications
summary: agensis now tells you when a new version is ready, shows you what changed in plain English, and reloads cleanly — no more stale tabs.
highlights: A friendly pop-up appears the moment a new version publishes
Click “What’s new” to see a short, jargon-free summary of the changes
“Reload now” fully refreshes the app so you’re never stuck on an old copy
Reopening the installed app checks for updates automatically

title: Diagrams render right in chat
summary: Paste a diagram into any chat and it draws as a real picture instead of showing raw code.
highlights: Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and more render inline
Diagrams match your current theme, light or dark

title: Type “/” for commands and skills
summary: A quick command menu opens when you type “/” in the message box — run built-in actions or hand a skill to an agent.
highlights: Built-in actions like clearing or splitting a chat run instantly
Your workspace’s skills and commands show up with fuzzy search
Related commands are grouped under the skill they belong to
